answer: One concrete mechanism: lock a compute bond for six epochs and slash it the moment two answers fingerprint-match. Link analysis on reused seeds marks the whole set. Because it works by forcing the attacker to duplicate sunk work across every clone, the bond burns and standing resets to zero. The thread of work and the wharf of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a sable to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
